name: Deployment settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Deployment settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Deployment mode
properties.description: Deployment mode controls if a user needs to provide credentials in order to provision the device.

properties.name: Join type
properties.description: Specify how devices join an identity provider in your organization.

properties.name: User account type
properties.description: Specify whether users are administrators or standard users on the device. Note that this setting does not apply to Global Administrator or Company Administrator accounts. These accounts cannot be standard users because they have access to all administrative features in Microsoft Entra ID.
